title: DetectionEvidence
description: Structured detection indicator produced by signature, ML, or behavioral analysis engines.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier for this piece of evidence.

incident_id.description: Identifier of the security incident this evidence is attached to.

source.description: Engine or module that generated this detection signal (e.g. yara, ml_pe, canary_monitor).

indicator.description: Specific rule, model feature, or pattern that matched.

severity.description: Severity rating of the observed indicator.

observed_value.description: Observed value or matching artifact string.

confidence.description: Confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0 representing certainty of the detection.

score_contribution.description: Numeric point contribution towards the composite risk score.

observed_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when the indicator was observed.

analysis_job_id.description: Optional identifier of the originating analysis job.
